s.note: the family gathered around Nai Nai's table
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 150g finely chopped wombok, ginger, soy and sesame oil. Fill 30 gow gee wrappers, fold and boil for 5 minutes. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.
Smash 2 cucumbers with a rolling pin and break into chunks. Toss with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp soy, sugar and chilli oil.

m.n: Wedding banquet sweet and sour pork
m.note: the cousin's wedding banquet for Nai Nai
m.how: Coat 600g diced pork in cornflour and fry until crisp. Toss with capsicum, pineapple and 200ml sweet and sour sauce. Serve with 300g steamed jasmine rice.

w.note: the sweet course at the banquet
w.how: Mix 250g glutinous rice flour with 60g sugar and 200ml hot water into a dough. Wrap around teaspoons of red bean paste, roll in sesame seeds and fry at 170C until golden.

d.how: Steep 4 jasmine tea bags in 1L water just off the boil for 3 minutes. Pour into small cups and keep the pot topped up.
